concept_uz: Buvining pianinosi yigirma yildan ortiq jim turdi, hamma uni buzuq derdi. Buvi olamdan oʻtgach, nevara qopqogʻini ochadi — klavishlar yangidek, ovoz tiniq. Burilish: pianino hech qachon buzilmagan; buvi bobo vafot etgan kuni chalishni toʻxtatgan va «buzuq» deyishni osonroq deb bilgan.

facts.claim: Pianino yillar davomida yopiq turgan, oila uni buzuq deb bilgan
Buvi oʻtgan bahorda vafot etgan; nevara uyni boʻshatayotganda qopqoqni ochgan, klavishlar deyarli yangidek
Buvi bobo vafot etgan kuni, yigirma yildan koʻproq oldin, chalishni toʻxtatgan; bu boboning sevimli ovozi edi
Buvi sotmagan ham, bermagan ham — qopqoqni yopib, hammaga buzuq deb ishonishga yoʻl qoʻygan, chunki bu tushuntirishdan osonroq edi
Nevara bolalikdagi darslardan eslagan yagona kuyni chaladi, onasi yonida turadi

style_line: Cinematic photoreal drama, soft spring daylight through lace curtains, gentle dust in the light, warm muted tones of walnut wood and faded fabric, 35mm film look, quiet intimate mood. No text, no letters, no watermark.

lines.text: Buvimning pianinosi yigirma yildan ortiq jim turdi. Hamma uni buzuq derdi.

scenes.prompt: Slow push-in through the quiet living room toward the old upright piano in the corner. Dust floats in a beam of spring sunlight; the closed lid is grey with dust. Audio: a wall clock ticking, distant street sounds, total stillness in the room. An off-screen man says in Uzbek with a soft, warm young Uzbek male voice, about twenty-five, quiet and thoughtful: "Buvimning pianinosi yigirma yildan ortiq jim turdi. Hamma uni buzuq derdi." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Buvim bahorda olamdan oʻtdi. Uyni yigʻishtirayotib, birinchi marta qiziqib qoldim.

scenes.prompt: Medium shot. The young man stands before the closed piano holding a cardboard box, sets the box down, and slowly draws one finger through the dust on the lid, looking at the clean line it leaves. Audio: cardboard thump, soft footsteps, the clock ticking. An off-screen man says in Uzbek with a soft, warm young Uzbek male voice, about twenty-five, quiet and thoughtful: "Buvim bahorda olamdan o'tdi. Uyni yig'ishtirayotib, birinchi marta qiziqib qoldim." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

Close-up on his hands. He lifts the heavy wooden lid slowly, bracing for broken keys; the lid opens to reveal clean ivory keys that look almost new. His face shows surprise. Audio: a long wooden creak, his breath held. He whispers in Uzbek with a soft, warm young Uzbek male voice, about twenty-five, amazed: "Klavishlari... xuddi yangidek." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

Extreme close-up: one finger presses a single white key, gently. A soft, clear piano note rings out and fills the room; dust in the sunbeam seems to tremble. He presses a second key, then a third. Audio: three clean piano notes, then silence. He says in Uzbek with a soft, warm young Uzbek male voice, about twenty-five, barely above a whisper: "Buzuq emas-ku..." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Oyi, qarang! U umuman buzuq emas!

scenes.prompt: The mother stands frozen in the doorway, one hand on the door frame, staring at the open piano as if she were seeing a ghost. Her eyes fill with tears. Slow push-in on her face. Audio: the last note fading, a quiet gasp. An off-screen young man says in Uzbek with a soft, warm young Uzbek male voice, about twenty-five, excited and confused: "Oyi, qarang! U umuman buzuq emas!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Bu dadamning eng sevgan ovozi edi. U ketgan kuni buvang chalishni toʻxtatdi.

scenes.prompt: Warm, softly glowing memory. The grandmother plays the piano while the grandfather listens beside it, smiling, eyes closed. The light slowly fades and cools; the grandfather is gone, and the grandmother, alone, slowly closes the lid and rests her hand on it. Audio: a gentle old melody that stops mid-phrase, then silence. An off-screen woman says in Uzbek with a gentle, slightly tired middle-aged Uzbek female voice, about fifty, softly: "Bu dadamning eng sevgan ovozi edi. U ketgan kuni buvang chalishni to'xtatdi." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Buzuq deyish osonroq edi… nega chalmasligini tushuntirishdan koʻra.
